best_lineage.idea: Replace the naive std::strtod wrapper with a manual decimal parser that accumulates up to ~19 significant digits into a uint64_t mantissa, tracks decimal exponent, uses Clinger's fast path for simple cases (≤19 sig digits, |exp| ≤ 22), and precomputes powers of 5 in a lookup table for fast base-10-to-binary conversion; fall back to std::strtod only for ambiguous or complex cases.
